name: Generative Engine Optimization
author: SuperSharpAI

sections.description:
🧠 Boost your site’s visibility in Google AI and other Generative Search Engines.

Generative / Answer Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO) is becoming as important as traditional SEO. With Google Search increasingly powered by AI snapshots, SGE (Search Generative Experience), and chat-based summaries, websites that are AEO-ready (Answer Engine Optimized) will have a competitive advantage.

This plugin helps your site appear in those AI-generated responses by injecting structured data (JSON-LD schema) directly into your site without showing FAQs in home page. It is especially useful for:

  • Being picked up in Google’s AI summary answers (at the top of search result)
  • Helping ChatGPT and Gemini find clear answers from your site
  • Boosting visibility in smart assistants (Alexa, Siri, etc.)

For more information Click Here

🎯 Features:

  • Add, Edit, Delete Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
  • Real-time preview of JSON-LD schema (auto generated)
  • Automatic add into site <head>
  • Clean and interactive admin UI with emojis and icons
  • Optimized for AI & traditional SEO

How It Works

  1. Go to the Generative Engine Optimization menu in your WordPress admin.
  2. Add as many FAQs as needed.
  3. JSON-LD schema is auto-generated based on your entries.
  4. This structured data is automatically inserted into your site’s HTML <head>, making it easier for AI to read and use.
  5. Real-time preview shows you exactly what data is sent.
    View A 2 mins YouTube video guide to use it

Contribution

Developed by SuperSharpAI.com — Visit Website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via WordPress admin
  3. Go to Admin > Generative Engine Optimization
  4. Start adding FAQs
sections.faq:
Will this plugin help with Google AI answers?

Yes. Google’s AI uses structured data to generate summaries. This plugin creates FAQPage schema that is highly compatible with Google’s AI and SGE (Search Generative Experience).

Can I use this with other SEO plugins?

Absolutely! It won’t conflict with plugins like RankMath or Yoast. This only manages FAQs.

Where is the JSON-LD added?

It’s inserted into your site’s <head> using wp_head, making it visible to crawlers and AI engines.

How Generative Engine Optimization plugin help me?

This Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) WordPress plugin is designed to help you optimize your content specifically for AI-generated answers — not just for traditional SEO. Here’s how this innovative plugin can benefit your website:
Optimize for AI Answer Engines
Structured Data with JSON-LD
User-Friendly UI + Full Control
Easy to setup and Use
0 technical knowledge required

Is Generative Engine Optimization required for WordPress?

Yes. This Generative Engine Optimization plugin transforms your WordPress site into an AI-ready content hub — ensuring your pages are readable, extractable, and referenceable by modern generative engines and answer tools.
